So I loaded my house with
a bunch of new furniture.

.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00}What?! What more

{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
Ma laadisin oma maja
uut mööblit täis.

.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00}Mida?! Mida sa veel
minult tahad,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, I put a bunch of
new furniture and stuff in
my place.
{07 0d 00}It really brings the room
together, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, ma panin oma koju
hunniku uut mööblit ja
muud kraami.
{07 0d 00}See seob toa tõesti
kokku, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}I'm using this new furniture
I got every day,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 13 00}It really limbers my back
up when I do shrugs with it
on my shoulders!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Kasutan seda uut mööblit
iga päev,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 13 00}See teeb mu selja tõesti
nõtkeks, kui teen sellega
õlgadel kehitusi!
